schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: WITH CTE AS(SELECT TIV_2015, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*) >=2), CTE2 AS(SELECT COUNT(PID) AS CNT, CONCAT_WS(',', LAT, LON) AS LOC FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY 2 HAVING COUNT(PID) = 1 ) SELECT SUM(TIV_2016) AS TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM CTE) AND CONCAT_WS(',', LAT, LON) IN (SELECT LOC FROM CTE2)
